Postsynaptic neuromuscular-junction failure; ophthalmoparesis and ptosis are common hallmarks, reported in 1/1 here. Respiratory muscle weakness does not establish lung injury.
Immune-mediated encephalomyelitis within the stiff-person spectrum; rigidity and myoclonus reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than primary muscle disease.
NEXN-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy directly affects myocardium; hypertrophy is reported in 6/6.
Craniosynostosis and acanthosis define disease; hydrocephalus 3/4 and choanal atresia 30–79%. Frequent ocular inflammation and conductive hearing loss omitted because of the cap.
